condition: subDays/addDays work in the system's local time, so when the range crosses a DST change, a date built from UTC moves by 23 or 25 hours and the UTC time-of-day shifts by an hour.
workaround: To do the math in UTC, wrap the date in UTCDate from @date-fns/utc. To move by exactly 24 hours, use subHours(date, 24) instead.
